notes.value: Laboratories Credit Union Limited (LCU) is a very small mutual based in North Ryde, northern Sydney. It was founded in 1954 by CSIRO employees and "started off with just 30 or so members and has grown over the years and now has over 3,000 members extending well beyond CSIRO staff and their families" - so membership is no longer strictly limited to CSIRO, but LCU does not publish a formal eligibility/common-bond statement anywhere on its site. Products include Simple Home Loan (owner occupied and investment), Intelligent Mortgage Variable, and a First Home Buyer Loan available only to first home buyers, offering "an ongoing discount of 0.50% off our Intelligent Mortgage Variable Loan Rate for the first 3 years after funding" for owner occupied principal-and-interest loans only. Simple Home Loan fees: $200 application fee, $0 annual fee, $0 monthly fee. NO BROKER CHANNEL WAS FOUND: no broker page, aggregator panel, accreditation form or third-party lending guide - lending enquiries go to lending@lcu.com.au. It appears to be direct-to-member only.
notes.sourceTitle: Laboratories Credit Union - About us; Simple Home Loan Owner Occupied; First Home Buyer
